Privacy.title: PRIVACY
Privacy.s1Body: Fjorr is built to be simple. Watching stays open. Accounts are optional membership — for a Scout name, watch history, and contributions when you choose to join. We don't sell your data or follow you around the internet for ads.
Privacy.s2p1: We collect personal information when you choose to give it: your email for the newsletter, and — if you create an account — your email for magic-link sign-in plus the Scout name and profile details you save.
Privacy.s2p2: Like most sites, our hosting provider receives basic server logs: browser, device, approximate location (city-level), pages visited, and when. These help keep Fjorr secure and running; they don't identify you as a person on their own.
Privacy.s2p3: If you watch while signed in, we may store watch progress and film logs on your account so your Voyages can remember what you've seen. Device-local progress may also be stored in your browser until you sign in.
Privacy.s3Body: Newsletter email is only for film updates and the occasional note — unsubscribe anytime. Account email is only for signing you in (magic link) and account-related messages. We don't share, sell, or trade your email.
Privacy.s4Item2: Run advertising trackers or ad IDs
Privacy.s4Item4: Require an account to watch films
Privacy.s4Item5: Share Scout profiles publicly unless you turn that on
Privacy.s4Item6: Use tracking cookies for third-party ads
Privacy.s5Body: We use Mux to stream films — it may collect anonymous playback data so video works. Supabase stores account and membership data when you sign in. If we use an email service for the newsletter or magic links, it stores your address only to reach you. We'll update this page if that changes.
Privacy.s6Body: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal data. Email us and we'll help — including deleting an account and associated membership data. Unsubscribe removes you from the newsletter list right away.
Privacy.s7Body: If what we collect or how Fjorr works ever changes, we'll update this page.

Terms.s4Body: Fjorr 以「現狀」提供服務。我們無法保證完美或不間斷的存取，但我們會盡力維持服務順暢運作。
Terms.s5Body: 在法律允許的範圍內，Fjorr 對於您使用本網站所產生的任何損害不承擔責任。

Principles.p3Body: 生命有陰影。我們不迴避。我們也不停在那裡。

Plus.modeInvite: Sign in to mark a moment for the desk.
Plus.bodyPlaceholder: What did you notice? What would you change?
Plus.signInRequired: Sign in to send a note.
Plus.rateLimited: One note per film per day. Try again tomorrow.
Plus.logsBody: Craft notes you’ve sent on films. Private — desk only.
Plus.infoP1: Fjorr films aren’t frozen. They can get sharper over time — a cut, a hold, a line, a cue. Walt Disney called it plussing.
Plus.infoP2: In Plus, mark what you notice. If you can make it better yourself — say so. Notes go to the desk, private.
Plus.infoP3: Craft is welcome. The director keeps final say. The archive improves carefully.
Plus.how1: Open any film. Tap Plus in the theater.
Plus.how2: Pause on the moment. Write what you'd change — or what already works.
Plus.how3: Send to the desk. Private. One note per film per day.
Plus.leadP1: A feature costs too much to risk. A five-minute film doesn't. That's the opening short form has always had — cheap enough to try the wrong idea and find the right one.
Plus.leadP2: Films on Fjorr ship as v1 — not a rough draft, but not the last word either. When something's worth making better, we make it better. We call that the plus.
Plus.whatP1: A film ships when it's ready, not when it's perfect — because perfect doesn't exist on day one. Members can flag what's not landing. If the Bureaux agrees, they plus it: a sharper edit, a better score, a scene that finally works, an idea nobody was brave enough to try the first time. v2 goes live. v1 doesn't disappear — it stays in the changelog, credited, archived, visible.
Plus.whatP2: Nothing gets overwritten. It gets versioned.
Plus.whoP1: Members don't edit films. They file the report. The Bureaux — the director, the editor, the composer, whoever built it — decides if the report's right, and if so, they're the ones who commit the change.
Plus.whoP2: Your name is on your work. It stays your work. v2 is still yours, made by you, because you agreed v1 could be better.
Plus.sectionSubmit: Or you can submit the patch yourself
Plus.submitP1: Sometimes the fix isn't a flag — it's already made. Sometimes it's bolder than a fix: a different score entirely, a cut that takes a real swing. If you can prove it's stronger, submit it. If the Bureaux agrees, it ships, and you're credited on it.
Plus.submitP2: This is how new names get pulled into the Bureaux — not by application, by proof.
Plus.whyP1: A feature can't afford to be wrong. A five-minute film can afford to try. That's not a compromise — it's the one advantage short film has always had over everything else, and almost nobody's used it. Every patch, every resubmission, every wild swing that actually lands is proof the format can hold more risk than anyone's asked of it.
Plus.closing: The best version hasn't shipped yet.
